error_reason: The WebSurfer agent repeatedly failed to scroll down or extract the specific birth date information from the Biography.com article (Turns 6, 8, 10) by only viewing the top navigation/header of the page. Although the Planner noted the date in its analysis (Turn 7, 11), the WebSurfer could not actually see it. Furthermore, the final search attempt for a New York Times article (Turn 14) failed to extract the birth date from the viewport which showed only the header/cookie banner, leaving the task with unverified conflicting data instead of a confirmed fact.

suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent stopped scrolling. Scroll down the page to find the 'Infobox' or the first paragraph of the biography section which typically contains the birth date.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis is incorrect. The WebSurfer successfully extracted the birth date from Britannica in Turn 10 ('January 4, 1949') and the text in Turn 10 clearly shows this information was seen by the agent. The error occurred later when the agent failed to scroll on Biography.com (viewport 7% in Turn 12/14), but the analysis incorrectly claims the agent 'repeatedly failed' from Turn 6-10 and that the Planner noted a date the WebSurfer couldn't see. In reality, the extraction at Turn 10 was successful, leading the Planner to note the discrepancy. The actual failure point is strictly Turn 12/14 regarding Biography.com scrolling, which the analysis mishandles by including non-faulty turns (6-11) in the error block.
